scripts.name: Setup Worktree
scripts.command: common_dir=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir) && main_root=$(dirname "$common_dir") && if [ "$PWD" != "$main_root" ] && [ ! -e .repos ] && [ ! -L .repos ]; then ln -s "$main_root/.repos" .repos; fi && vp i

scripts.name: Check
scripts.command: vp run typecheck && vp run lint && vp run test
